decision: per-stage scroll memory (model.rs `ScrollMemory`): a slot per StageKind (entity names included — another artist's albums is another slot), the egui fingerprint (query, sort key, generation the UI last saw) and the first viewable ROW as the position. Save: every viewability report records it (the egui per-frame end_section); restore: the FIRST report after a remount scrolls to the remembered row via scroll_to_index(row, 0%) — the plan's "virtual_list keeps its scroll while mounted, scroll_to_index restores it". A stale fingerprint resets to the top, the egui contract. Slots bounded at 32, oldest evicted. The egui module held drill columns to no offset (its columns stayed mounted between selections); here every stage unmounts and the walk re-enters, so per-stage memory is the restoration contract the plan asks for — recorded as the unit's own choice. The Folders stage has NO slot (the egui memory kept none; the tree is not a virtual list)
why: the plan's N7 line names scroll_to_index; the fingerprint idea maps one to one
